description: Defines ASN.1 structures and choice types for UL-CCCH messages in 5G NR RRC protocol, including message type enumeration, choice handling, and serialization methods.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice type for UL-CCCH message, including various request types and message classification.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the complete UL-CCCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type or choice option.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Accesses the 'c1' choice within the message type.
